lessons.trigger_condition: a validated static-data candidate remains unmerged beyond report freshness or receives code/workflow commits before external promotion
lessons.prevention_rule: static-data candidate branches may change only the 17 approved public JSON outputs plus integrity_manifest.json; reject stale auto_update_report in candidate CI; Drive packaging must keep the two-hour freshness gate and dispatch a fresh protected static collection instead of publishing stale evidence
validation_required: static candidate diff contains only approved public JSON outputs and integrity_manifest.json
auto_update_report remains within the two-hour freshness window when candidate CI runs
stale Drive packaging dispatches a fresh TCG Static Data Refresh without uploading a stale package
repository integrity and Tablet GPT exact watched-path alignment pass on the exact candidate head
lessons.safety_boundary: do not widen freshness limits, do not publish stale data, do not direct or force push main, and do not claim deferred physical Drive delivery as verified
